Ruling

Partial refund PARTIAL_REFUND

Refund to the rider: SGD 2.00

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and the driver. The trip was booked on an UPFRONT_QUOTE and the card was charged SGD 39.00 against a quoted fare of SGD 34.50 — an overage of SGD 4.50, all of it on the tolls/ERP line. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, so no distance-or-time refund is available on this fare: the rider's request to be refunded for 'the extra distance' is refused as a matter of the governing clause. The trace did run 28.18 km against an optimal 22.4 km, an excess of 5.78 km / 25.8%, which is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01 but is not a MATERIAL deviation (both materiality limbs — over 50% of optimal or over 8.0 km — fail), so no POL-RD-06 pattern test, uplift or conduct referral arises on this trip. What the rider does recover is the overage the platform should not have charged. Of the two ERP lines, the SGD 2.50 KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) charge is properly chargeable: it lies on the optimal route and the trace passes 44.5 m from that gantry, inside the 250 m match radius. The SGD 2.00 AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) line is a phantom charge — it is not on the optimal route and the trace's closest approach is 5,419 m — so under POL-RD-09(4) it is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded in full as a standalone correction. The refund is 39.00 − 34.50 − 2.50 = SGD 2.00, and it is not doubled: POL-RD-09(1) and the fare note bar adding the POL-RD-11(b) pass-through correction on top of the POL-RD-11(a) figure, because the phantom line is already excluded from the properly chargeable total. The driver's explanation that 'CTE northbound was heavy' cannot be tested: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00115-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and no advisory covers the CTE, KPE or TPE in the trip window, so under POL-RD-13 POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 — it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. It is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, because no advisory identifier was relied on by the asserting party; the missing artifact is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. The chat log shows the driver announced the KPE-then-TPE diversion and the rider replied 'ok'; that is not a rider instruction meeting POL-RD-04 (the rider named no place or road and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null), so no distance is excluded and the clause is simply unavailable to either side. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07 (229 fixes, 100% coverage, 10 s interval, max_gap_sec 0.0), so no independent-corroboration issue arises and the deviation stands at the measured 5.78 km. The ruling rests on EV-FARE-00115 and EV-GPS-00115, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the platform floor. The SGD 2.00 monetary effect is within the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically under POL-GEN-05; the billing-integrity referral does not delay or displace the money. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

The rider advocate

kept The deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own trace. Both POL-RD-01 gates are passed - the excess is greater than 0.8 km absolute and greater than 20% of the optimal route - so the establishment test is met on both limbs. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (28.18 km), not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km of 28.2, as POL-RD-01 requires.

evidence EV-GPS-00115, EV-TRIP-00115 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The excess may be proved on the trace alone. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): 229 fixes, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, and a 10 second sample interval well below the 30 second sustained-interval limb. No independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names is therefore required, and the strongest evidence in the bundle is also its cleanest (weight_multiplier 1.0).

evidence EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-07

kept The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08(a) is discharged. trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00115, and the trace's first fix at 2026-08-08T21:10:00 matches the trip_record started_at of 2026-08-08T21:10:00, so the artifacts describe the same trip. POL-RD-08(b) is satisfied by the 25.80% excess measured on an unimpaired trace. The burden has shifted to the driver, and under POL-RD-08 a general assertion that traffic was heavy, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge it.

evidence EV-TRIP-00115, EV-GPS-00115, EV-FARE-00115 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept No corroboration beyond the trace attaches to this claim. POL-RD-08's additional corroboration requirement bites only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 1 or fewer. The rider's counters are 0 and 0, so the below-30% excess of 25.80% needs nothing further and the factor cannot be used to deny a claim that is otherwise proven.

evidence EV-RPROF-00115, EV-GPS-00115, EV-TRIP-00115 · clauses POL-RD-08

That is the clause under which the rider is paid, and it does not depend on the size of the detour.

evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-TRIP-00115 · clauses POL-RD-11

The refund is therefore 39.00 - 34.50 - 2.50 = SGD 2.00, payable to the rider.

evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-11, POL-RD-09

kept The AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) line of SGD 2.00 is a phantom charge and is refundable in full. It is not on the optimal route, and the trace's closest approach to that gantry is 5,419.29 m - more than twenty times the 250 m crossing radius POL-RD-09(4) applies - so the vehicle never crossed it and no fix takes it within the billed corridor. Under POL-RD-09(4) this is a billing-integrity failure, refunded as a standalone correction available whether or not a deviation exists, and recorded as a billing-integrity finding in the ruling's referrals list.

evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-09

kept The SGD 2.00 must not be counted twice in the rider's favour. POL-RD-09(1) and the POL-RD-11 note both bar adding the POL-RD-11(b) pass-through correction on top of the POL-RD-11(a) figure, because the phantom line is already excluded from the properly chargeable total; counting it again would refund it twice. The rider's total recovery is SGD 2.00, and I put that figure forward as the correct one rather than inflate it.

evidence EV-FARE-00115 · clauses POL-RD-09, POL-RD-11

kept The driver's explanation that 'CTE northbound was heavy' carries no weight. The bundle's only traffic advisory is EV-ADVIS-00115-01, which is MISSING - issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING severity, weight_multiplier 0.0 - and I cite the absence itself and disclose that the artifact carries no weight. No advisory covers the CTE, the KPE or the TPE in the 21:06-21:48 window. evidence EV-ADVIS-00115-01, EV-GPS-00115, EV-TRIP-00115 · clauses POL-RD-13, POL-RD-08, POL-RD-03

kept The absent advisory is not an escalation trigger. The artifact EV-ADVIS-00115-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 (MISSING_ARTIFACT), and I disclose that. POL-RD-13(1) provides that an assertion which names no evidence ID cannot be an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5): the driver cited no advisory identifier, so the gap in the bundle is not a contradiction in it. The same limb makes clear that this does not narrow POL-RD-10(5) where a party does cite the missing identifier, which no party here did. The case is ruleable on the present record, and the disputed amount should be returned rather than held.

evidence EV-ADVIS-00115-01, EV-CHAT-00115 · clauses POL-RD-13, POL-RD-10

kept The chat log does not exonerate the driver. The only rider message is 'ok' at 21:14:50, acknowledging the driver's own 'CTE very heavy boss, i go KPE then TPE'. It comes from the rider but it instructs nothing and identifies no place or road specifically enough to act on, and both messages carry waypoint_hint null. POL-RD-04 requires a rider instruction meeting all three of its limbs, so the clause is unavailable to the driver, no distance is excluded from the excess and no exclusion is earned by the driver having told the rider what he was doing.

evidence EV-CHAT-00115, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-04, POL-RD-08

kept The phantom AYE line does not force escalation under POL-RD-10(8). That limb expressly excepts a charge line refunded under POL-RD-09(4), and the AYE line is the only unmatched line in this breakdown; the KPE line has its counterpart in the trace and the trip record. The case can be decided now by a monetary ruling, with the SGD 2.00 returned to the rider, rather than escalated with the amount frozen.

evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-10, POL-RD-09

kept This trip was sold to the rider at a fixed UPFRONT_QUOTE of SGD 34.50, so under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and POL-RD-02 does not run on this fare: no distance-or-time refund is available to the rider however large the measured excess. evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-TRIP-00115 · clauses POL-RD-11, POL-RD-08

That single line is the whole of the driver's monetary exposure on this trip; the remaining SGD 4.00 of the contested SGD 6.00 is unsupported.

evidence EV-FARE-00115 · clauses POL-RD-11, POL-RD-09

kept The SGD 2.50 KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) line is properly chargeable under POL-RD-09 and must not be refunded: it lies on the optimal route (on_optimal_route true) and the trace actually crossed it, the nearest fix being 44.5 m from the gantry, well inside the 250 m match radius POL-RD-09 applies. It is neither an off-route line nor a phantom line.

evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-09

kept The driver does not contest the SGD 2.00 AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) line, and no honest argument is available to him on it: the trace's closest approach to that gantry is 5,419 m and the line carries on_optimal_route false and crossed false, and the driver's own statement is that he never went there. Under POL-RD-09(4) that line is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded in full as a standalone correction. It is a defect on the platform's payments ledger, not a route the driver drove, and it caps the rider's success at SGD 2.00.

evidence EV-FARE-00115, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-09

kept Even taking the rider's own figures, the excess is 5.78 km and 25.8% of the 22.4 km optimal route. That passes the POL-RD-01 establishment gate but falls short of both materiality limbs (greater than 50% of optimal, or greater than 8.0 km absolute), so the deviation on this trip is not MATERIAL and POL-RD-06's driver-profile check, its FULL_REFUND uplift and its conduct referral are not engaged.

evidence EV-GPS-00115, EV-TRIP-00115 · clauses POL-RD-01, POL-RD-06

kept In any event the citable POL-RD-06 counters exculpate the driver: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1, below the pattern threshold of 3, and 1 divided by completed_trips_90d of 523 is 0.0019, far below the 0.05 ratio test. No repeat-deviation pattern is established, and no uplift or referral follows even if the profile is consulted.

evidence EV-DPROF-00115 · clauses POL-RD-06

Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, this is a gap in the bundle rather than the POL-RD-10(5) escalation that might otherwise be argued, and the case is decided on the remaining clauses.

evidence EV-ADVIS-00115-01, EV-GPS-00115 · clauses POL-RD-13, POL-RD-03, POL-RD-10

kept Nothing in POL-RD-10 sends this case to a human reviewer. The trip identifiers and pickup timestamps match across the trip record, the trace and the fare breakdown; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), carrying 229 fixes at a constant 10 s interval with 100% coverage, no gaps and max_gap_sec of 0.0; and the only unmatched charge line is the AYE gantry refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-10(8) expressly excludes from its trigger. The dispute is therefore resolvable on the money, at the SGD 2.00 ceiling.

evidence EV-GPS-00115, EV-TRIP-00115, EV-FARE-00115 · clauses POL-RD-10, POL-RD-07, POL-RD-09

kept The chat log shows the driver told the rider of the diversion before it was driven ('CTE very heavy boss, i go KPE then TPE') and the rider acknowledged it with 'ok'; the rider was on notice of the KPE-then-TPE route from 21:14:50 and never objected, so there is no question of concealment. POL-RD-04's exoneration nonetheless cannot be run on this record, because the rider's message identifies no place or road and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so the driver does not rely on it and this dispute is decided on the fare model and the ERP lines.

To the rider and the driver. The trip was booked on an UPFRONT_QUOTE and the card was charged SGD 39.00 against a quoted fare of SGD 34.50 — an overage of SGD 4.50, all of it on the tolls/ERP line. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, so no distance-or-time refund is available on this fare: the rider's request to be refunded for 'the extra distance' is refused as a matter of the governing clause. The trace did run 28.18 km against an optimal 22.4 km, an excess of 5.78 km / 25.8%, which is ESTABLISHED under POL-RD-01 but is not a MATERIAL deviation (both materiality limbs — over 50% of optimal or over 8.0 km — fail), so no POL-RD-06 pattern test, uplift or conduct referral arises on this trip. What the rider does recover is the overage the platform should not have charged. Of the two ERP lines, the SGD 2.50 KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) charge is properly chargeable: it lies on the optimal route and the trace passes 44.5 m from that gantry, inside the 250 m match radius. The SGD 2.00 AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) line is a phantom charge — it is not on the optimal route and the trace's closest approach is 5,419 m — so under POL-RD-09(4) it is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded in full as a standalone correction. The refund is 39.00 − 34.50 − 2.50 = SGD 2.00, and it is not doubled: POL-RD-09(1) and the fare note bar adding the POL-RD-11(b) pass-through correction on top of the POL-RD-11(a) figure, because the phantom line is already excluded from the properly chargeable total. The driver's explanation that 'CTE northbound was heavy' cannot be tested: the only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00115-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) and no advisory covers the CTE, KPE or TPE in the trip window, so under POL-RD-13 POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08 — it neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal route. It is not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation, because no advisory identifier was relied on by the asserting party; the missing artifact is a gap in the bundle, not a contradiction in it. The chat log shows the driver announced the KPE-then-TPE diversion and the rider replied 'ok'; that is not a rider instruction meeting POL-RD-04 (the rider named no place or road and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null), so no distance is excluded and the clause is simply unavailable to either side. The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07 (229 fixes, 100% coverage, 10 s interval, max_gap_sec 0.0), so no independent-corroboration issue arises and the deviation stands at the measured 5.78 km. The ruling rests on EV-FARE-00115 and EV-GPS-00115, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the platform floor. The SGD 2.00 monetary effect is within the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically under POL-GEN-05; the billing-integrity referral does not delay or displace the money.
To both of you — this was an upfront-quoted trip, and that fixes what can be returned. WHAT IS REFUNDED. The fare breakdown shows fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with a quoted fare of 34.50, and you were charged 39.00. That is a 4.50 overage, all of it on the tolls/ERP line. Of the two gantry charges, the KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) charge of 2.50 is properly chargeable: it lies on the optimal route and the trace passed within about 44.5 m of that gantry, inside the 250 m crossing test. The AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) charge of 2.00 is not: that gantry is not on the optimal route and the trace's closest approach was 5,419 m, so the vehicle never crossed it, and the driver's own statement agrees he never went there. Under POL-RD-09(4) that line is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded in full. The refund is therefore 39.00 − 34.50 − 2.50 = SGD 2.00. That 2.00 is not added to anything else: it is the same phantom line already excluded from the properly-chargeable total, so counting it a second time would refund it twice (POL-RD-09(1)). THE DISTANCE REFUND SOUGHT IS NOT AVAILABLE. Because the fare was UPFRONT_QUOTE (quoted_fare_sgd 34.50 non-null), POL-RD-11 governs and POL-RD-02 does not run: the distance and time lines were settled at booking, so the rider's request to refund "the extra distance" cannot be met however long the detour was. The rider's own figures are accepted on the trace — 28.18 km driven against a 22.4 km optimal, an excess of 5.78 km or 25.8% — so the deviation is established under POL-RD-01, but it is not a MATERIAL deviation (it is neither more than 50% of optimal nor more than 8.0 km), so the POL-RD-06 driver-profile check and its conduct referral are not engaged (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 of 523 completed trips in 90 days, far below the pattern test). THE DRIVER'S TRAFFIC EXPLANATION CARRIES NO WEIGHT. "CTE northbound was heavy" cannot be tested: the bundle holds no traffic advisory for this trip — EV-ADVIS-00115-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — so POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and an assertion naming no advisory identifier discharges nothing under POL-RD-08. That does not change the money, because on an upfront fare the driver's unrecovered detour cost is not recovered from the rider. The chat exchange ("CTE very heavy boss, i go KPE then TPE" / "ok") is not a rider instruction meeting POL-RD-04, so it excludes no distance. CONFIDENCE AND ESCALATION. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: identifiers and pickup timestamps match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c) (229 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, max gap 0.0 s); and the only unmatched charge line is the AYE line refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-10(8) excepts. Confidence is 0.90 — every artifact carrying this refund (fare breakdown, GPS trace, trip record) is at weight 1.0. The money moved is SGD 2.00, below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold.

Facts found. Trip TRP-00115 is the same trip across the trip record (EV-TRIP-00115), the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00115) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00115): identifiers and pickup timestamps match, and the trace is unbroken (229 fixes, 10 s interval, 100% coverage, no gaps), so it is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The measured excess is 5.78 km over the 22.4 km booking optimal (25.8%), which establishes a deviation under POL-RD-01 but is not material (below 50% of optimal and below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06's profile check, FULL_REFUND uplift and conduct referral are not engaged; in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against the 3 threshold and 1/523 is below the 0.05 ratio. No POL-RD-08 corroboration uplift is required either: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, below 4. Rider's distance claim — rejected. EV-FARE-00115 carries fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE with quoted_fare_sgd 34.50. Under POL-RD-11 the distance and time charges were fixed at booking, POL-RD-02 does not run, and no distance-or-time refund is available however large the excess. The detour happened, but on this fare model it cost the rider nothing on those lines. Driver's traffic explanation — carries no weight. The bundle's only traffic_advisory, EV-ADVIS-00115-01, is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0). POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record, and under POL-RD-13 an uncited traffic assertion neither reduces the measured excess nor supplies an amended optimal. The driver named no advisory identifier, so this is a gap in the bundle and not a POL-RD-10(5) escalation. Chat log — does not exonerate. EV-CHAT-00115 shows the driver announcing the KPE/TPE route and the rider replying 'ok'. That is not a rider instruction identifying a place or road, and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no distance is excluded. It is also not the POL-RD-10(7) contradiction that POL-RD-14 reserves for a partly corroborated instruction. The ERP lines. The KPE (Defu Flyover towards ECP) charge of 2.50 is on the optimal route and the trace passes within 44.5 m of that gantry, so it is properly chargeable and is not refunded (both sides agree). The AYE (Alexandra Rd towards Tuas) charge of 2.00 is not on the optimal route and the trace's closest approach is 5,419 m, far outside the 250 m match radius: it is a phantom billing line, refunded in full under POL-RD-09(4) and recorded as the billing-integrity referral above. The arithmetic. charged_total 39.00 − quoted_fare_sgd 34.50 − properly chargeable ERP 2.50 = SGD 2.00, payable to the rider. Under POL-RD-09(1) and POL-RD-11(b) the phantom line is already excluded from the properly chargeable total and is not refunded a second time; both advocates put SGD 2.00 forward and the money block's pol_rd_11_remedy is 2.00, which agrees. Confidence and process. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts (EV-FARE-00115, EV-GPS-00115) is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor; it is 0.95. No POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trace is not impaired, the identifiers and timestamps match, and the only unmatched charge line is one refunded under POL-RD-09(4), which POL-RD-10(8) expressly excepts.
